📰 BNB突然跌破720？背后是美元在反抗，还是大饼在拖累？

昨天下午 UTC 时间，BNB 在 24 小时内阴跌 3.69%，价格跌破 720 美元，收在 719.47 美元附近。这不算大跌，但市场明显在关注这个关键价位。对 BNB 生态和整个加密市场来说，这个价格节点意味着什么？

为什么这条新闻重要？
BNB 价格的变动从来不只是 BNB 的问题。首先，BNB 是币安的代币，也是以太坊生态的重要燃料代币，其价格走势往往反映了市场对币安生态活跃度、以太坊 L2 竞争力的综合预期。这次跌破 720 美元，表面看是 BNB 本身的需求问题，但更深层次可能是美元整体走强、加密市场情绪降温的信号。

从行业周期看，当前正值 10 月份的传统抛售期，叠加美联储降息预期减弱，美元指数走强。而 ETH 在 24 小时内跌 4.51%，跌幅大于 BNB，这意味着以太坊网络的疲软可能拖累了整个 L2 市场，尤其是与以太坊深度绑定的 BNB。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格的影响目前看主要是情绪层面。BTC 在 24 小时内跌 2.60%，但价格仍在 7.9 万美元上方，显示大饼的韧性。ETH 的下跌幅度更大，可能压制了整个加密市场的风险偏好。如果 BNB 继续下探，可能会引发对币安链和以太坊 L2 整体价值捕获能力的担忧，进一步打压市场情绪。

市场格局上，这不会改变美元计价下加密资产的弱势地位。资金流向可能继续从热门币种流向保值资产或小币种。历史上类似事件，比如 2022 年 L2 市场崩盘期，BNB 也曾跌破 700 美元，当时是叠加了宏观经济衰退和以太坊网络问题。

操作思路
目前看，BNB 跌破 720 美元更多是跟随市场下跌，而不是主动性的崩盘。如果美元指数继续走强，或者 ETH 无法企稳，这个价格位可能被跌破，形成更强烈的看跌信号。如果后续出现利好消息刺激，比如以太坊新功能进展超预期，或者币安宣布新生态政策，BNB 也有可能重新站上 720 美元。

失效条件：如果美联储突然宣布降息 50 个基点，美元指数跳水，BNB 跌破 720 美元的看跌逻辑可能作废。

Did you make a profit on the trade… after costs?

The price may move in the direction you expected, but your net profit could be lower than you think. When trading BTC or ETH, pay attention to the actual execution price and fees—not just the percentage increase in price.

Hypothetical spot trading example:
You buy an amount with an execution value of $1,000, then sell it for an execution value of $1,010. Profit before fees: $10.

Assuming a 0.1% fee for each trade, charged separately:

• Buy fee: $1.
• Sell fee: $1.01.
• Net profit: $7.99.

That means fees consumed 20.1% of the gross profit in this example! The assumed rate is not a statement of the fees on your account; check the fees for your trading pair and any discounts available to you.

There is also a difference between the price you expect and the price at which your trade executes: this is slippage, and it can work for or against you. Execution prices are more likely to differ when liquidity is low or your order is large relative to the available orders.

Note: Because this example uses actual execution values, we do not subtract slippage a second time; its effect is already reflected in those values.

Before trading, check the fees and order book depth. A limit order sets the acceptable price, but it may not execute, or may only execute partially. Afterward, review your execution history and calculate your net result.

Do you calculate your profits after fees?

content:
ربحت الصفقة… فهل ربحت بعد التكاليف؟

قد تتحرك العملة في الاتجاه الذي توقعته، لكن ربحك الصافي يكون أقل مما تتصور. عند تداول BTC أو ETH، راقب سعر التنفيذ الفعلي والرسوم، لا نسبة ارتفاع السعر وحدها.

مثال افتراضي لتداول فوري:
اشتريت كمية بقيمة تنفيذ 1000 دولار، ثم بعتها بقيمة تنفيذ 1010 دولارات. الربح قبل الرسوم: 10 دولارات.

إذا افترضنا رسمًا قدره 0.1% لكل عملية، مدفوعًا منفصلًا:

• رسم الشراء: دولار واحد.
• رسم البيع: 1.01 دولار.
• صافي الربح: 7.99 دولارات.

أي أن الرسوم استهلكت 20.1% من الربح الإجمالي في هذا المثال! النسبة المفترضة ليست إعلانًا عن رسوم حسابك؛ تحقق من رسوم زوج التداول والخصومات المتاحة لك.

وهناك فرق بين السعر الذي تتوقعه والسعر الذي تنفذ به الصفقة: هذا هو الانزلاق السعري، وقد يكون لصالحك أو ضدك. يزداد احتمال اختلاف التنفيذ مع ضعف السيولة أو كبر الطلب مقارنة بالأوامر المتاحة.

انتبه: لأن المثال يستخدم قيم التنفيذ الفعلية، فلا نخصم الانزلاق مرة ثانية؛ أثره موجود أصلًا في تلك القيم.

قبل الصفقة، افحص الرسوم وعمق دفتر الأوامر. الأمر المحدد يضبط السعر المقبول، لكنه قد لا ينفذ، أو ينفذ جزئيًا. وبعدها راجع سجل التنفيذ واحسب النتيجة الصافية.

هل تحسب أرباحك بعد الرسوم؟

تنويه: محتوى تعليمي وتحليلي، وليس توصية بالشراء أو البيع ولا ضمانًا للربح.

Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than simply deciding whether to use one. Place it too close and it gets triggered constantly; too far away and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure would be invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if price breaks that level, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

🚨 Ethereum delays an important upgrade... but is a delay really bad news?

Imagine you’re about to launch a new airplane, and just minutes before takeoff, engineers discover a potential problem with one of its systems.

Do you take off on schedule to prove you’re sticking to the plan? Or delay the flight until you’re sure everyone is safe?

✈️ That’s roughly the situation Ethereum’s developers faced!

A test related to the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet has been postponed due to technical concerns about the upgrade.

But there’s an important detail:

The delay doesn’t mean the Ethereum mainnet has stopped or been hacked.

Testing is there in the first place to catch problems before upgrades reach users.

💡 And here’s the irony:

In the tech world, we usually celebrate whoever launches their product first.

But in blockchain, the more responsible decision may be not to launch an upgrade until it’s ready.

A small error on a network managing billions of dollars in assets could cost far more than a delay of a few days.

translatedData.content:
Franklin Fund Shares Land on XRPL | Institutional Tokenization Isn’t Exclusive to ETH | Defend Around 2,340 First

My stance is to acknowledge that institutional demand for tokenization exists, but not to automatically count issuance on other chains as bullish for ETH. A Binance Square trending topic mentioned that Franklin added about $150 million in fund shares on the XRP Ledger. The evidence needs to be considered in layers: CoinDesk reported that, based on two on-chain subscription receipts and share issuances of about $75 million each, sgBENJI on the network rose from about 48 million shares to about 193 million; Franklin’s Singapore website confirms that sgBENJI is a share class of its OnChain U.S. Dollar Short-Term Money Market Fund, not the U.S. FOBXX; and an official DBS announcement last year confirmed that it was working with Franklin and Ripple on tokenized money market funds and an RLUSD solution on XRPL. However, I could not find a contemporaneous official Franklin press release about this increase in shares, nor can I infer from a single receiving wallet that one investor made the purchase, that net new money flowed into the overall market, or that funds moved to Ethereum.

The takeaway for ETH from this trending topic is competition. When institutions choose a chain, they need to assess compliance controls, custody and distribution, settlement currency, liquidity, and audit costs. Recording transactions on-chain does not automatically pass fund returns on to the underlying network token. If the shares remain on XRPL, the direct network activity will occur there first; for ETH to benefit, we need to see whether similar funds launch on Ethereum or its layer 2s and generate actual transactions and fees. A multichain strategy could also expand the overall market, so it would be simplistic to say that “ETH is losing institutions.” The investor’s identity, any cross-chain migration, and the ultimate economic benefits remain unclear.

The market has offered no direct evidence that ETH is benefiting. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,341.94, versus a daily open of $2,384.70, with a rolling 24-hour low of $2,326.44 and high of $2,410.81; the price is below the daily open, so the increase in XRPL shares cannot be described as a catalyst for an ETH rally. Farside’s October 23 U.S. ETH fund table shows visible entries totaling a provisional $4.4 million in inflows, while the ETHV figure is still missing. This is not a complete end-of-day total, and it is unrelated to Singapore’s sgBENJI fund. In the short term, I’m watching whether 2,326 holds, whether the price can reclaim 2,350–2,360, and then 2,385 and 2,411. If 2,326 breaks, the thesis that “institutional tokenization is helping ETH stabilize” should be rejected.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a small spot long if the conditions are met. I would enter with 0.35% of total capital only after two consecutive complete 15-minute candles close above $2,360 and a retest holds at $2,350–$2,360. I would take half off at the first target of $2,385, then close the rest near the second target of $2,410. After entry, if a 15-minute candle closes back below $2,342, I would first cut half of the remaining position; below $2,326, I would stop out of the entire position. If 2,326 breaks before the conditions are triggered, I would cancel the long plan, use no leverage, and avoid adding to a losing position. If future evidence shows that the additional institutional shares were merely an internal transfer, or that there is still no incremental adoption on Ethereum, I would also assign less weight to this narrative. I will never present an untriggered plan as a profitable trade.

Sources: CoinDesk’s on-chain analysis, Franklin’s Singapore product page, and DBS’s official partnership announcement; market data: Kraken ETH/USD. #FranklinTempletonAdds$150MFundSharesToXRPLedger #ETH
The above is solely my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
富兰克林基金份额落在XRPL｜机构代币化并非ETH独享｜2340附近先防守

我的态度是承认机构代币化需求存在，但不把别的链上发行直接算成ETH利好。币安广场热榜谈到富兰克林在XRP Ledger增加约1.5亿美元基金份额。证据要分层：CoinDesk根据链上两笔各约7500万美元认购凭证与份额发行，报道sgBENJI在该网络由约4800万份升至约1.93亿份；富兰克林新加坡官网确认sgBENJI是其OnChain美元短期货币市场基金的份额类别，不是美国FOBXX；星展银行去年官方公告确认与富兰克林及Ripple在XRPL推进代币化货币基金与RLUSD方案。但我未找到富兰克林对这次新增份额的同期正式新闻稿，也不能从单一收款钱包推断是一位投资者买入、净新资金流入整个市场，或转到了以太坊。

这条热榜对ETH的启示是竞争。机构选链，要评估合规控制、托管分销、结算货币、流动性及审计成本。链上记账不会自动把基金收益送给底层公链代币。若份额留在XRPL，直接网络活动先发生在那里；ETH要受益，需看同类基金是否在以太坊或二层落地、产生实际交易和费用。多链布局也可能扩大整个市场，不能简单写成“ETH失去机构”。投资者身份、跨链搬迁和最终经济收益仍不清楚。

市场没有给出ETH受益的直接证据。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2341.94美元，日开2384.70，滚动24小时低2326.44、高2410.81；价格在日开下方，不能把XRPL份额增加描述成ETH上涨催化。Farside的10月23日美国ETH基金表只显示可见项暂合计流入440万美元，ETHV一栏仍缺数，不是全日完整终值，也和新加坡的sgBENJI基金不是一回事。短线我看2326是否守住，2350—2360能否收复，再看2385及2411；若跌破2326，所谓“机构代币化带动ETH企稳”的判断就应推翻。

如果是我自己交易，现阶段不参与，方向仅考虑条件满足后的现货轻仓试多。需要连续两根完整15分钟K线收在2360美元上方，且回踩2350—2360守住，才以总资金0.35%入场；第一目标2385减半，第二目标2410附近清掉余仓。入场后15分钟收盘跌回2342下方，先减剩余一半；跌破2326则全部止损平仓。若触发前先跌破2326，取消多单计划，不用杠杆、不补亏损仓。今后若机构新增份额被证明只是内部调拨或ETH链上采用仍无增量，我也会降低这条叙事的权重；计划未触发绝不写成成交盈利。

资料：CoinDesk链上核查、富兰克林新加坡产品页、星展官方合作公告；行情：Kraken ETH/USD。#FranklinTempletonAdds$150MFundSharesToXRPLedger #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

The Fatal Mistake — Ignoring the Risk-Reward Ratio
Risk-Reward Ratio — A mistake that silently destroys your account

Risk-Reward Ratio
It compares the potential loss with the expected profit on a trade.
A 2:1 ratio = risk $1 to make $2

Crypto example: BTC • ETH • SOL
Real-life example:
Target: 64,000 → Stop-loss at 58,000 USDT (2,000-) → Correct 1:2 ratio
But without a stop-loss, the price drops to 55,000 → Loss of 5,000 = -2.5R

Why does this mistake happen?
 • No prior plan or stop-loss
 • Greed for quick profits
 • Revenge trading after a previous loss
 • Only enter if the profit is ≥ twice the loss

How it affects you — Trader psychology
Hope and denial — delaying closing the trade in the hope that the price will recover
Fear of missing out (FOMO) — entering randomly without analysis

Steps to protect yourself
 1- Don’t risk more than 1-2% of your capital
_(The remaining steps were repeated in the image due to the design. The correct steps are: Set a clear target, use at least a 1:2 ratio, and stick to the plan.)_

Beyond the charts, here's something I've been thinking about for a long time.

Graham's Mr. Market teaches us an important lesson:
Graham likened the market to a person with bipolar disorder who quotes you a price every day. When he's excited, he names an exorbitant price; when he's depressed, he sells for next to nothing. Your job isn't to catch his mood—it's to take advantage of it. In crypto, Mr. Market has several episodes a day.

Take today’s $ETH  as an example: currently 2,349, down 1.90% over 24 hours. This market action is a perfect illustration of the lesson above. It’s no coincidence; it’s human nature repeating itself in the charts.

The market won’t go easy on you just because you understand how it works.
Trim your positions first.

Knowledge Card: Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs)
The most commonly used NFT standard on Ethereum is ERC-721, where each NFT is distinguished by a unique tokenId.
CryptoKitties, launched in late 2017, once congested the Ethereum network and was one of the best-known early NFT projects.
Before listing NFTs on a marketplace, pay attention to what you’re authorizing. Granting one-time approval for an entire collection lets the other party transfer all the NFTs in that collection that you own.
Transferring and buying or selling NFTs on Ethereum requires $ETH  to pay for gas.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
The exchange simply collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t make money from them.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no delivery date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is above the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money changing hands pulls the contract price toward the spot price.

Let's talk about the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
Ethereum smart contracts are usually written in Solidity or Vyper, compiled into bytecode, and deployed on-chain, where the EVM executes the opcodes one by one.
To be honest, I hadn't paid attention to this before: before interacting with a contract, check on a block explorer whether its source code has been verified. Be especially cautious with contracts whose source code isn't public.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
If you don't understand a product yet, avoid taking a large position. Try it out with a small amount first.

以太坊市场深度分析：升级延迟叠加鲸鱼抛售短期承压明显

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十四日，以太坊现货价格报二千三百六十六点八九美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点九。价格从二千三百六十七美元附近开盘，盘中最高触及二千三百七十三美元，最低下探至二千三百六十三美元，整体呈现低位窄幅整理的走势，波动幅度较比特币更小。

从均线系统来看，当前价格已经跌破了七小时均线二千三百六十八美元、二十五小时均线二千三百八十四美元以及九十九小时均线二千四百二十二美元，均线系统呈现典型的空头排列。价格距离九十九小时均线存在约五十六美元的差距，显示中期趋势明显偏弱。布林带方面，上轨为二千三百九十九美元，中轨为二千三百七十八美元，下轨为二千三百五十七美元，价格目前在中轨下方运行，短期支撑关注二千三百五十七美元一线。

从成交量来看，最近一小时成交额约为六百六十三万美元，较前一小时的八百零六万美元有所萎缩，显示市场参与热情下降。在价格持续走低的背景下，成交量萎缩通常意味着多头信心不足，短期内缺乏有效的买盘支撑。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，当前MACD线为负八点六六，信号线为负八点三八，柱状图值为负零点二八。与比特币不同的是，以太坊的MACD柱状图虽然负值在收窄，但尚未转正，空头动能仍在释放中。MACD线和信号线均在零轴下方运行，短期看空信号明确。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为三十七点七，十二周期RSI为三十八点八，二十四周期RSI为四十一点二。各周期RSI均处于偏低区间，六周期RSI接近超卖区域，但尚未触及三十以下的极端超卖水平。这意味着以太坊仍有进一步下探的可能，但距离技术性反弹的条件正在接近。

KDJ指标方面，K线为三十八点八，D线为三十八点零，J线为四十点四。三线在低位区域粘合，尚未形成明确的金叉或死叉信号，显示市场处于方向选择的关键时刻。如果K线能够上穿D线并带动J线快速拉升，则有望触发技术性反弹。

威廉指标显示当前读数为负六十五点八，处于中性偏弱区间。随机RSI指标读数为三十三点五，已经接近超卖区域，其均线为三十五点七，两者均处于低位，暗示短期可能存在超跌反弹的机会。

三、市场情绪分析

从消息面来看，以太坊面临多重利空因素。首先，Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网上被推迟，原因是EIP至八零三七被发现存在智能合约安全隐患，可能导致合约操作被永久记录而无法重试。这一延迟使得十二月作为主网升级候选窗口被排除，给市场信心带来打击。

其次，知名投资者Arthur Hayes清仓了约两千两百万美元的资产，其中包括ETH、ENA、UNI等多个代币，完全清空了Maelstrom基金的方向性头寸。Hayes表示地缘政治紧张和宏观不确定性是其选择离场的主要原因。此外，链上数据显示存在六千四百至八千枚ETH的鲸鱼抛售，以及休眠ICO钱包的转移，进一步加剧了卖压。

从资金流向来看，以太坊小时级别的净流出峰值达到两千五百七十万美元，持续的资金外流对价格形成了直接压制。不过从积极面来看，RSI接近超卖区域、随机RSI进入低位区间，以及MACD柱状图负值收窄，都暗示空头力量可能正在接近衰竭。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临升级延迟、鲸鱼抛售和资金外流的三重压力，技术面偏空格局明确。但多项振荡指标已接近超卖区域，一旦市场情绪企稳或出现利好催化，技术性反弹的力度可能较为可观。建议投资者关注二千三百五十七美元的布林带下轨支撑，以及二千四百零二美元的超级趋势线阻力位。

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

【Step 1】Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of your position size.
【Step 2】The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position and lower your leverage, or add more margin.
【Step 3】Maintenance margin level: Once your losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Guys, this is a concept you really need to understand: the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)!
Ethereum smart contracts are generally written in Solidity or Vyper. After being compiled into bytecode, they’re deployed on-chain, where the EVM executes opcodes one by one.
The EVM charges Gas for each instruction. When a transaction runs out of Gas, it stops and rolls back any state changes, so an infinite loop can’t bring the whole network to a halt.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paying with $ETH . Currently 2367.32.

On-chain revenue cools｜Down about 18% on a seven-day basis｜Don’t chase a rebound near $2,366

My stance is to play defense first and not equate a single metric—“on-chain revenue”—with the price of ETH. Binance News relayed data from growthepie today showing that, on its seven-day comparison basis, users paid about $2.16 million in on-chain fees on Ethereum mainnet, down about 18% from the previous comparison period. Base saw about $550,000, down roughly 3.3%, while Polygon PoS recorded about $422,000, down around 20%. This reflects changes in fee-paying activity over a specific time window; it is not the Ethereum Foundation’s profit, nor can it be directly added up as cash dividends for ETH holders. growthepie’s original definition of Chain Revenue is the fees users pay to execute transactions on-chain, and it cautions that fee subsidies, priority inclusion, and other factors can affect interpretation. Its daily summary also shows mainnet still ranking first among the chains tracked, but daily and seven-day percentages use different bases and should not be conflated.

Why does this news matter for trading? Part of ETH’s long-term narrative depends on on-chain demand, burning, and validator rewards. If user fees remain weak, the market may question whether “application growth is truly flowing back into value capture for mainnet.” But lower fees may also result from scaling making transactions cheaper; they do not necessarily mean users are disappearing. L2 activity and mainnet fee revenue are not the same thing, so mainnet’s seven-day revenue alone is not enough to declare the ecosystem in decline. To assess this further, I would track transaction volume, L2 settlement fees, ETH burned, and active mainnet accounts to see whether they are moving in tandem, rather than focusing on a single dollar figure.

The market reaction is subdued for now, but the entire decline cannot be attributed to this data. At the time of writing, Binance’s price page showed ETH at about $2,366, down roughly 1.4% over 24 hours, with a range of about $2,351 to $2,414. Meanwhile, the U.S. spot ETH fund table from Farside for October 23 showed a provisional net inflow of about $4.4 million across the entries reported so far, but the ETHV column was still blank, and the automated total does not represent final, complete fund flows. The complete table for October 22 had shown a net outflow of about $110.6 million. A falling price, incomplete fund data, and slower on-chain fee activity can be observed side by side, but they should not be turned into a causal story that “institutions sold ETH because of this.”

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now. I would only consider a small long position after confirmation, with no more than 2% of total capital at risk and no high leverage. I would consider scaling in between $2,400 and $2,415 only if ETH moves back above $2,415, holds above $2,400 on a retest, subsequent fund data is fully reported, and on-chain fees stop weakening. The first target is $2,450, where I would take half off; the second target is $2,500, where I would close the remaining position. I would stop out immediately if the price falls below $2,370 after entry. I would also exit early if the price rises while trading volume keeps shrinking, or if both on-chain and fund data weaken at the same time. If the price first breaks below $2,350, the bullish view is temporarily invalidated, and I would stay out of the market while waiting for new evidence. All price levels are conditional plans that have not been triggered; they are not executed trades or realized profits.

Sources: growthepie’s metric definition and data pages, Binance News, Farside’s ETH fund table, and Binance’s ETH price page. #ETH

ETH链上收入降温｜七日口径下降约18%｜2366美元附近不追反弹

我的态度是先防守，不把“链上收入”一个指标等同于ETH价格。币安新闻今天转述growthepie数据：以其七日比较口径，Ethereum主网用户支付的链上费用约216万美元，较前一比较期下降约18%；Base约55万美元、降约3.3%，Polygon PoS约42.2万美元、降约20%。这反映的是特定时间窗内付费活动的变化，不是以太坊基金会的利润，也不能直接加总成ETH持有人的现金分红。growthepie对Chain Revenue的原始定义是用户为链上执行支付的费用，且提醒手续费补贴、优先打包等会影响解读；其页面日度摘要也显示主网仍位居跟踪链第一，但日度与七日百分比不是同一口径，不能混写。

这条消息为何影响交易？ETH的长期叙事部分依赖链上需求、销毁与验证者收益。如果用户费用持续变弱，市场会质疑“应用增长是否真正回流到主网价值捕获”；但费用下降也可能来自扩容后交易更便宜，未必意味着使用者消失。尤其L2活动与主网收费不是一回事，不能仅凭主网七日收入就宣布生态衰退。要进一步检验，我会追踪交易量、L2结算费用、ETH销毁和主网活跃账户是否同步变化，而不是只盯一个美元数。

市场反应目前偏弱，却不能把跌幅全归因于这份统计。币安价格页写稿时ETH约2366美元，24小时跌约1.4%，区间约2351至2414美元。同期Farside的10月23日美国现货ETH基金表中，已填报的部分暂显示约净流入440万美元，但ETHV栏仍是横线，自动合计不代表最终完整资金流；此前10月22日完整表约净流出1.106亿美元。价格走低、基金数据未齐、链上付费放缓这三件事可以并列观察，不能编成“机构因此抛售ETH”的因果故事。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅保留确认后轻仓试多，仓位不超过总资金2%，不使用高杠杆。只有ETH重新站上2415美元、回踩2400美元不破，并看到后续基金数据完成披露且链上付费不再继续走弱，才考虑在2400至2415美元分批入场。第一目标2450美元，触及减半；第二目标2500美元，余仓到位平仓。入场后跌破2370美元立即止损；若价格上涨但成交持续缩量，或者链上与基金数据同时转弱，也会提前平仓。若先跌破2350美元，则偏多判断暂时失效，保持空仓等待新证据。所有价位是条件计划，尚未触发，绝非已成交或已获利。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

[Cross Margin] Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
All the positions in the basket can support one another.

[Isolated Margin] Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

📰 Why is the BTF fund liquidation paying out cash and accelerating expiration?

When Binance’s liquidity mining protocol BTF announced it was shutting down, investors faced a dilemma: their funds might be locked up forever. Now, a new announcement from CoinShares offers a solution: cash compensation for remaining contract holders, while bringing forward the options’ expiration date. This directly changes how investors can exit, but not everyone is happy about it.

Why does this matter?
At its core, this change alters BTF’s risk-reward profile. Investors used to be betting that the protocol could operate indefinitely. Now they’re betting that the cash compensation will be worth more than holding until expiration. This shift hints at underlying market pressure: liquidity protocols may struggle to sustain positive returns indefinitely. Regulatory pressure may be the main reason—if a protocol operates like a crypto asset manager, it may have to settle regularly. Accelerated expiration means investors face uncertainty sooner, but at least they get a predictable cash flow. Compared with other liquidity mining products, such as PancakeSwap’s yPool, BTF’s move looks more like the approach taken by traditional financial institutions, but it comes at the cost of giving up the possibility of high returns over the long term.

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC and ETH is limited, but this reflects the survival challenges facing liquidity protocols. The BTF case suggests that similar protocols may need to adopt faster liquidation cycles or make their yield models more transparent. If more protocols encounter similar problems, it could trigger a wave of redemptions. Historically, whenever regulation tightens, the most “unusual” protocols tend to attract scrutiny first. For example, during the major DeFi downturn in the summer of 2023, many innovative protocols went straight to zero. BTF is now taking steps to survive. On the other hand, this could also send remaining liquidity back to more compliant platforms.

Trading perspective
This news suggests that the risk facing liquidity protocols is shifting from “the protocol shutting down for the long term” to “the cash value shrinking.” This assessment would no longer hold if other liquidity products—especially leveraged ones—ran into similar problems.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
Each EVM opcode has a corresponding Gas cost. Operations like writing to storage are much more expensive than ordinary computation.
Once a contract is deployed, its bytecode is fixed and anyone can view it. Whether its source code is available depends on whether the developer has published it on a block explorer.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
Understanding how it works helps you make informed decisions; it’s not about trying to predict the market.

看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, here’s the long-term calculation: 60% × 50% − 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade.
That looks like a positive expectation. But consider the path: two losses in a row leave you down 75%, and you need a 300% gain just to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. This is the Gambler’s Ruin theorem playing out every day in crypto.
Everyday reality.

Take the same strategy, but only use 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row mean an 18% loss—hardly a knockout blow.
You still get the benefit of the strategy’s long-term expectation. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has—and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

title: 以太坊回到2400美元下方，BiyaPay观察：ETH等的只是比特币反弹吗？
subTitle:
币圈调整时，ETH常被一句“跟着BTC走”解释。但如果只等比特币反弹，就容易漏掉以太坊自身的问题：网络有人用，是否就意味着ETH会有更强的买盘？
10月24日撰稿时，ETH约2364美元，过去24小时区间约2354至2414美元。2400美元附近出现反复，但这组价格本身，不能证明底部已经形成。
资金端也有压力。美国现货以太坊ETF在10月19日至22日合计净流出约2.25亿美元，其中22日净流出约1.11亿美元。21日虽然出现约1490万美元净流入，却没有改变这四个交易日整体流出的方向。
这里先分清一件事：这只是ETF渠道的变化，不代表全部ETH持有人的决定，更不能直接推出机构已经一致看空。但在其他条件相近时，持续赎回会减少一个重要渠道的需求支持。
所以，ETH要走出更有说服力的修复，需要的不只是BTC涨一根阳线，还要看自己的资金与使用需求能否改善。
首先，链上热闹与代币升值之间，并没有自动转换。
以太坊交易需要支付Gas，基础费用会被销毁。但交易笔数增加，不一定让总费用按同样比例增加。如果单笔成本下降很快，即便用户更活跃，销毁规模也未必同步扩大。判断供应变化，还要把新增发行与销毁放在同一期间比较。
因此，应用更多、使用更便宜，可以改善网络竞争力，却不能直接等同于ETH马上变得更稀缺。网络好用与资产买盘增强，需要分别验证。
其次，质押不等于卖压永久消失。
质押参与网络安全并获得奖励，但符合条件后可以退出，部分参与者也能通过流动性质押相关工具调整敞口。不能把所有质押ETH，都当成永远不会回到市场的筹码。
分析供应，重点不是挑一个很大的锁仓数字，而是看进入、退出与可交易需求如何变化。持币数量增加，也不保证能覆盖价格下跌带来的美元计价损失。
对于持有USDT、同时考虑ETH与美股等不同资金用途的用户，比如BiyaPay作为全球一站式资产配置平台，覆盖数字资产、美股、港股和法币兑换等场景，提供了集中查看不同市场行情的入口。
再看行情，值得跟踪的是三个方向：ETF赎回是否缓和；ETH相对BTC是否出现持续改善；网络使用增加之后，费用、销毁与供应变化能否提供支持。这里列的是观察项目，并非认定它们已经转好。
如果价格反弹、资金仍持续流出，说明修复可能还缺少稳定需求；如果资金改善、价格也能在回撤后保持稳定，判断才更有依据。单日上涨不能替这些验证全部作答。
我更愿意把2400美元看成观察位置，而不是自动触发上涨的开关。ETH能否走强，既受整体市场影响，也需要自己的需求跟上。应用增长最终能否转化成持续持有意愿，比“生态很热闹”更值得追踪。
仅作市场讨论，不构成投资建议。

ETH and U.S. Tax Trending Topic | Penalty Relief Is Still a Proposal, Not a New Rule | Hold Above $2,350 Before Considering an Entry

My stance is cautious and watchful: I wouldn’t translate the words “tax penalty relief” directly into an ETH bullish signal. The hashtag #IRSPlansLowerTaxDisclosurePenaltiesForCryptoCases is gaining traction on Binance Square right now, but it’s important to distinguish three layers of the story: media reports that officials want to revise the voluntary disclosure program describe a plan; the penalty-relief framework published by the IRS in December 2025 is a proposal open for comment; and the final rules that actually apply are still pending formal publication by the IRS. These three things should not be conflated into “crypto investors have already received penalty relief.”

According to media coverage of a tax conference on October 23, IRS officials hope to introduce revisions before year-end and shorten processing times; the reports gave no final tax rate or effective date. The verifiable text on the IRS website says the existing voluntary disclosure program is primarily aimed at people who may have willfully evaded taxes, rather than sweeping ordinary bookkeeping errors into the program. The 2025 proposal sets the accuracy-related penalty for amended returns at 20% per year, and the website also makes clear that the proposal creates no vested rights before it is finalized. Another commonly confused point is Form 1099-DA: brokers reporting digital asset transactions in phases does not mean that holders are exempt from tax obligations. ETH users who frequently swap tokens or use on-chain applications would be better off keeping their own transaction records, cost basis information, and filing documents. This is about managing compliance expectations, not evidence that demand for ETH will rise immediately.

Why should traders still pay attention? If the rules are ultimately clarified, the cost of calculating tax uncertainty could fall for institutions and individuals, potentially improving willingness to participate over the longer term. But today’s news includes neither new official text nor quantifiable spot buying of ETH. Market reaction must be viewed separately from the narrative: at the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,363, versus a daily open near $2,385, with a rolling range of roughly $2,350 to $2,415, and was still below the daily open. This price movement cannot be attributed solely to the tax reports. Farside’s ETH fund table for October 23 shows only about +$3.6 million for FETH and about +$800,000 for MSSE, while ETHV is still missing a figure. The page’s total of about +$4.4 million reflects only the figures currently visible, so it would be premature to declare that the whole market’s net inflows are settled.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the move. I’d only consider a small spot position to test the upside, with no high leverage. I would consider entering in stages using 2% of my total capital only if ETH regains and holds above $2,385, then retests without breaking below it, and the next round of fund data is complete with no significant net outflows. My first target would be $2,415; I’d take half off there and look to $2,450 for the remainder. If ETH falls back below $2,350, I’d stop out. If the IRS’s formal document differs from media expectations, or if the price spikes and then loses $2,385 again, I’d close the remaining position. If these conditions never occur, I’d stay out and wait—an untriggered plan does not count as a trade. The key invalidation conditions are that the formal rules fail to materialize, fund flows weaken, or $2,350 is lost. No matter how much attention the tax story gets, it cannot replace confirmation.

#IRSPlansLowerTaxDisclosurePenaltiesForCryptoCases #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH与美国税务热榜｜减罚仍是提案不是新规｜守住2350再谈参与

我的态度是谨慎观望，不把“税务减罚”四个字直接翻译成ETH利好。币安广场此刻的#IRSPlansLowerTaxDisclosurePenaltiesForCryptoCases正在上升，但需要把消息的三个层次分开：媒体报道官员希望调整自愿披露程序，是计划；美国国税局2025年12月公布的减罚框架，是征求意见的提案；真正适用的最终条款，仍要等IRS正式公布。三者不能写成“加密投资者已经获得减罚”。

据10月23日媒体对税务会议的报道，IRS官员希望在年底前推出修订，并缩短处理周期；报道没有给出最终税率或生效日期。回到IRS官网可核实的文字，现有自愿披露程序主要针对可能涉及故意逃税的人，而不是把普通记账差错一概纳入；2025年提案给出的修正申报准确性罚款为每年20%，官网也明确说提案未最终实施前不产生既得权利。另一个常被混淆的点是1099-DA：经纪商按阶段报送数字资产交易，不等于持币人的纳税义务被免除。ETH用户若频繁换币、参与链上应用，交易记录、成本基础和申报材料更值得自己留存；这属于合规预期管理，不是ETH需求会马上增加的证据。

为什么它仍值得交易者关注？规则若最终清楚，机构和个人计算税务不确定性的成本可能下降，长期可能改善参与意愿；但今天的消息既没有新的正式文本，也没有可量化的ETH现货买盘。市场反应必须与叙事分开看：写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2363美元，日开约2385，滚动区间约2350至2415，仍在日开下方；不能把这段波动单因归于税务报道。Farside的10月23日ETH基金表仅见FETH约+360万美元、MSSE约+80万美元，ETHV仍缺栏，页面合计约+440万美元只是当前可见值，不宜宣布全市场净流入已定案。

如果是我自己交易，我现在不追单，方向仅考虑现货小仓试多，不开高杠杆。只有ETH重新站稳2385美元且回踩不破、同时下一轮基金数据补齐后没有明显净流出，我才考虑用总资金2%分批入场；第一目标2415美元，触及先减半，余仓看2450美元。若跌回2350美元下方则止损，若IRS正式文件与媒体预期不符或价格冲高后重新失守2385美元，就平掉剩余仓位。若条件一直未出现，就是空仓等待，绝不把未触发计划算作成交。核心推翻条件是正式规则未落地、资金流转弱或2350失守；税务话题再热，也不能代替确认。

#IRSPlansLowerTaxDisclosurePenaltiesForCryptoCases #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Why do people buy when prices are high and sell when prices are low?

The answer is often human psychology.

The crypto market is driven not only by charts, news, and liquidity, but also by emotions that influence millions of decisions.

🚀 EUPHORIA: Everyone believes prices will keep rising.

💰 GREED: Investors want more and take excessive risks.

😰 FEAR: Red candles create uncertainty and doubt.

🔻 PANIC: Investors rush to sell without a clear plan.

💎 HOPE: After a downturn, confidence slowly returns.

The cycle repeats, but disciplined investors understand that emotions should never replace research and risk management.

5 rules for smarter crypto decisions:
✅ Research before investing.
✅ Never blindly follow the crowd.
✅ Set risk limits and stick to your strategy.
✅ Avoid emotional buying and panic selling.
✅ Be patient and think long term.

🔥 Remember: You cannot control the market, but you can control how you respond to it.

Now look at positioning. $BTC  long/short position ratio: 2.20, $ETH 3.15, $ETH  funding rate: +0.0058%. Longs are an overwhelming majority, and the funding rate is still positive, so leveraged long positions haven’t been washed out much.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover that your losses
Your trade journal is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

Market conditions change, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

ETH｜The 14% in the PEPE trending topic is not the current gain｜Check on-chain demand before chasing the rally

My stance is cautious: I wouldn’t chase ETH just because an altcoin rebound is trending. The exact topic on Binance Square right now is “#Pepe leads the altcoin rebound with a 14% gain.” That figure describes the market when the topic emerged; it should not be treated as the live gain at the time of writing. At the time of writing, Kraken’s spot quote for PEPE was about $0.000004493, below its daily open of about $0.000004561; ETH was about $2,345, also below its daily open of about $2,385. These two quotes only describe the market right now. They do not prove that PEPE is driving ETH, or that the altcoin market as a whole has completed a reversal.

Why is this trending topic still worth watching for ETH traders? Etherscan identifies the PEPE contract as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum. Ethereum’s official documentation states that mainnet transaction fees are paid in ETH, and that the base fee is burned. If the buzz translates into real mainnet transfers, swaps, and sustained demand for block space, it could indirectly affect the ETH supply-and-demand narrative through fees and burning. But “PEPE’s price is rising” does not mean “mainnet usage is rising”: trades may take place only on centralized exchanges, or be executed on other networks or through wrapped assets. Even if mainnet transactions increase, the scale of fees relative to ETH’s market cap must be assessed separately; a meme coin’s percentage gain cannot be mechanically mapped onto ETH.

There are three things to verify now: First, whether PEPE can reclaim and hold above its daily open, so we don’t mistake the stale 14% figure for current momentum. Second, whether ETH itself can reclaim around $2,360 and hold there, rather than merely bouncing from a low. Third, whether subsequent mainnet transactions, base fees, and burning improve in tandem. If social discussion heats up but there is no confirmation from both ETH’s price and on-chain usage, I’d classify it as sentiment rotation, not a sudden change in ETH fundamentals. ETH’s intraday low touched about $2,280 today, leaving plenty of room for volatility. First consider how much a mistaken call could cost, then think about how much you could make.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t enter for now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with no leverage. I’d open a position with no more than 0.4% of my total funds only if ETH closes above $2,360 on the one-hour chart, then holds the $2,350–$2,360 range on a retest, and PEPE does not make a new intraday low. The first target is $2,388; I’d take half off there. The second target is $2,410, where I’d close the entire position. If ETH falls below $2,320 after entry, I’d stop out immediately. If two consecutive one-hour candles close back below $2,350, I’d exit even if the hard stop hasn’t been hit. If the price breaks below $2,280 before entry, the plan is void. These price levels are execution conditions, not a guarantee of future market movements. If the trending buzz fades or on-chain demand isn’t confirmed, I wouldn’t add to the position just because “PEPE once gained 14%.”

我的态度是谨慎，不因为一条山寨币反弹热榜就追ETH。币安广场此刻的准确话题是“#Pepe上涨14%领涨山寨币反弹”。这个数字描述的是话题形成时的行情，不能当作我写稿时的实时涨幅。Kraken现货报价截稿时，PEPE约0.000004493美元，低于其当日开盘约0.000004561美元；ETH约2345美元，也低于当日开盘约2385美元。两个报价只能说明眼下的盘面，并不能证明PEPE带动ETH，或证明整个山寨板块已完成反转。

为什么这条热榜仍值得ETH交易者看？Etherscan将该PEPE合约标识为以太坊上的ERC-20代币；以太坊官方文档明确，主网交易手续费由ETH支付，基础费被销毁。若热度转化为主网真实转账、兑换与持续区块空间需求，才可能通过手续费与销毁机制间接影响ETH的供需叙事。但“PEPE价格涨”不等于“主网使用量涨”：交易可以只发生在中心化交易所，也可能在其他网络或包装资产上完成。即使主网交易上升，费用规模相对ETH市值仍要单独衡量，不能把一枚迷因币的百分比涨幅机械映射到ETH。

现在要分三层验证：第一，PEPE是否重新站稳日内开盘，避免把过期的14%当成当前动量；第二，ETH自己能否重新收复约2360美元并维持，而不是只在低位反抽；第三，后续链上主网交易、基础费与燃烧是否同步改善。若只看到社交讨论量升温，却没有ETH价格与链上使用的双重确认，我会把它归类为情绪轮动，而不是ETH基本面突变。今天ETH日内低点曾到约2280美元，波动空间足够大，先考虑错误判断会损失多少，再考虑能赚多少。

【Like after the 2016 DAO incident, Ethereum is being forced to answer for the first time: Can blockchain withstand the real world?】

ETH has pulled back 52.6% from its peak this cycle, bringing its price to around $2,343, while the Fear & Greed Index sits at 51. Honestly, market sentiment isn’t exactly warm, but long-term investors are taking another look at whether ETH is worth holding.

I’m more concerned about another front: security. Initia paused its mainnet and Rollups because of a vulnerability, sending more than $2.6 million in assets to Ethereum; after the Cysic bridge was attacked, the attacker made off with $744,000 worth of ETH and BNB and laundered the funds through Tornado Cash; and the Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet was delayed because changes to gas fees could affect 13 real-world contracts.

In practice, this means projects that rely on Ethereum for settlement, cross-chain operations, and Rollups will come under direct pressure. Users bear the losses, developers bear the costs of audits and fixes, and confidence in ETH as a secure settlement layer will be repriced. This isn’t a case of “the price is down, so it’s cheap.” It’s about whether the infrastructure can keep risks contained.

I’ve always seen ETH’s long-term thesis as a “foundation for programmable assets.” Whether that thesis holds up depends not on a single upgrade, but on vulnerability disclosures, compensation mechanisms, testnet validation, and projects’ ability to migrate. My approach is to first ask who bears the losses, then whether the fixes can be verified, and finally whether similar projects are being forced to change their architecture. If those three things aren’t addressed, even the grandest ecosystem story is just window dressing.

Do you think this security narrative is a short-term disruption, or the starting point of a genuine reassessment of ETH’s infrastructure value?

这轮ETH从高点回撤52.6%，价格来到2343美元附近，恐惧贪婪指数51。说真的，市场情绪谈不上热，长线资金却在重新审视它到底值不值得拿。

我更关心另一条线：安全。Initia因漏洞暂停主网和Rollups，超过260万美元资产流向以太坊；Cysic桥被攻击后，攻击者拿到74.4万美元ETH和BNB并洗进Tornado Cash；Glamsterdam Hoodi测试网又因13个真实合约可能受Gas改动影响而延期。

落到实处，这意味着依赖以太坊结算、跨链和Rollup的项目会直接承压，用户承担损失，开发者承担审计与修复成本，ETH作为安全结算层的信任也会被重新定价。这不是“跌了就便宜”的逻辑，而是基础设施有没有把风险关进笼子。

ETH的长期叙事，我一直认为是“可编程资产底座”。能不能持续，不看一次升级，而看漏洞披露、赔付机制、测试网验证和项目迁移能力。我的判断方法是：先看损失由谁承担，再看修复是否可验证，最后看同类项目是否被迫改架构。做不到这三点，讲再大的生态故事也是包装。

这波安全叙事你觉得是短期扰动，还是ETH真正进入基础设施价值重估的起点？

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Posted Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, we forget every bit of sound advice, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

One: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t write one down, don’t enter.
Two: Never let a single trade lose more than 2% of your capital. No exceptions.
Three: Don’t add to losing positions. Never average down.
Four: After three consecutive losses, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Five: Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is gone from the account; the mindset you build stays with you.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Upgrade Delays and Selling Pressure Test Key Support

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 19:00 on October 24, 2026, Ethereum’s spot price stood at $2,341, down approximately 2.34% over the past 24 hours. The intraday low was $2,294, followed by a rebound to around $2,350. The latest five hourly candlesticks show a steady recovery. The first candle opened at $2,306 and closed at $2,318, with a trading volume of 17,548 ETH, equivalent to $40.49 million. Prices then gradually moved higher, with the latest candle reaching a high of $2,350 and closing at $2,346. The Bollinger Bands’ upper, middle, and lower bands are at $2,405, $2,359, and $2,312, respectively. The price is currently below the middle band, with around $60 of room to the upper band. The ATR is 16.73, indicating that volatility has declined from previous levels and the market has entered a relatively stable consolidation phase.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, the 7-period MA is at $2,330, the 25-period MA at $2,364, and the 99-period MA at $2,415. The three lines are in a typical bearish alignment, with the price below all of them, suggesting a weak medium-term trend. The EMA readings—$2,339 for the 7-period, $2,360 for the 25-period, and $2,397 for the 99-period—also confirm the bearish setup. The MACD shows a DIFF line at -15.69, a DEA line at -14.67, and a histogram at -1.02. Although the readings remain negative, their absolute values are steadily shrinking, indicating that bearish momentum has weakened noticeably. The 6-period RSI is at 51.57, back in neutral territory, while the 12-period and 24-period RSI readings are 43.36 and 41.55, respectively, suggesting some recovery in short-term momentum. On the KDJ indicator, K is at 57.35, D at 47.38, and J at 77.29. All three lines are moving upward but have not entered overbought territory, leaving room for further gains. The Williams %R is -37.59, in neutral territory. Overall, technical indicators suggest that Ethereum’s short-term recovery from oversold conditions is underway, but medium-term moving-average resistance remains pronounced.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing multiple headwinds. First, delays to the network upgrade have had a negative impact. The Glamsterdam upgrade was postponed on the Hoodi testnet after a smart contract security flaw was discovered. ChainSafe found that the contract could permanently record operations that were supposed to be retryable, creating potential gas-related risks. Lido DAO has voted to roll back the relevant contracts, but the incident has shaken developer confidence. Second, institutional selling pressure is mounting. Prominent investor Arthur Hayes liquidated approximately $22.28 million in crypto assets, including 6,400 ETH, adding to market fears. Spot ETFs have continued to see net outflows, with cumulative outflows exceeding $485 million in mid-to-late October. However, there are positive factors as well: the long-term staking ratio has reached 36% of supply, and some institutions have been accumulating at the lows, providing a measure of price support. 以太坊市场深度分析：升级延迟叠加抛压考验关键支撑

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十四日十九时，以太坊现货价格报二千三百四十一美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之二点三四。盘中价格最低触及二千二百九十四美元，随后反弹至二千三百五十美元附近。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现稳步回升态势。第一根K线开盘二千三百零六美元，收盘二千三百一十八美元，成交量一万七千五百四十八枚ETH，折合四千零四十九万美元。随后价格逐步走高，最新一根K线最高触及二千三百五十美元，收盘二千三百四十六美元。布林带上轨二千四百零五美元，中轨二千三百五十九美元，下轨二千三百一十二美元，价格目前在中轨下方运行，距离上轨仍有约六十美元的空间。ATR指标报十六点七三，波动率较前期有所下降，市场进入相对平稳的震荡阶段。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线报二千三百三十美元，二十五周期均线报二千三百六十四美元，九十九周期均线报二千四百一十五美元，三线呈典型空头排列，价格运行在所有均线下方，中期趋势偏弱。EMA七报二千三百三十九美元，EMA二十五报二千三百六十美元，EMA九十九报二千三百九十七美元，同样确认空头格局。MACD指标显示DIFF线负十五点六九，DEA线负十四点六七，柱状图负一点零二，虽然仍为负值但绝对值在持续缩小，空头动能明显减弱。RSI六周期报五十一点五七，已回到中性区域，十二周期报四十三点三六，二十四周期报四十一点五五，短期动能有所恢复。KDJ指标中K值五十七点三五，D值四十七点三八，J值七十七点二九，三线向上运行但未进入超买区域，仍有上行空间。威廉指标负三十七点五九，处于中性区域。综合技术指标来看，以太坊短期超卖修复正在进行，但中期均线压制依然明显。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重压力。首先是网络升级延迟的负面影响，Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网上因智能合约安全缺陷被推迟，Chainsafe发现合约可能将本应可重试的操作永久记录，引发Gas相关风险。Lido DAO已投票回滚相关合约，但这一事件打击了开发者信心。其次是机构抛售压力，知名投资人Arthur Hayes清仓了约二千二百二十八万美元的加密资产，其中包括六千四百枚ETH，加剧了市场恐慌情绪。现货ETF持续净流出，十月中下旬累计流出超过四亿八千五百万美元。不过积极因素同样存在，长期质押比例已达到供应量的百分之三十六，部分机构在底部增持，为价格提供了一定支撑。链上OBV指标虽然为负但持续改善，从负六十四万五千改善至负六十二万三千，卖压正在逐步减轻。当前价格需要关注二千三百美元的关键支撑，若能有效守住，有望展开技术性反弹。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year would multiply your money by 12; earning a steady 10% a month,
would multiply it by 30 over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are worth waiting for, while discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
but the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

ETH | Reclaims $2,300 after breaking below it | Don’t rush to buy the dip when the fund table has a missing entry

My stance is to remain defensive. ETH reclaiming $2,300 does not mean selling pressure is over. According to Binance market data cited by the verified Binance News account, ETH briefly fell below 2,300 USDT at 15:17 UTC on October 24, trading at around 2,291.09 USDT, down about 4.5% over the previous 24 hours. This was a market update at the time, and does not mean ETH is still at that price now. I just checked Kraken, where ETH/USD was around $2,335.1. Although it has reclaimed $2,300, it is still below the day’s opening price of $2,384.7, with an intraday low of around $2,279.8. The trading pairs and times on the two exchanges differ, so these figures should not be treated as the same trade, and the rebound should not be called a trend reversal.

I also watch institutional demand, rather than focusing on a single round-number level. Farside’s current table shows a net outflow of about $110.6 million from US spot ETH ETFs on October 22. On October 23, the apparent net inflow was about $4.4 million, but the ETHV entry is still marked as missing. So it would be unwise to treat that day’s figure as final, let alone claim that institutions have fully returned. The short-term mechanics are simple: a price dip can trigger forced deleveraging, followed by buying back at lower levels. Fund flows operate on a slower timescale and do not necessarily track intraday price movements one-for-one. So the break below $2,300 that day and the missing table entry the next day warrant, at most, cautious monitoring; they do not support claims like “ETF inflows are rescuing the market.” If later updates show a clear improvement, I’ll revise my view.

The level I’m watching is whether $2,300 can hold. Below that, I’m watching the day’s low near $2,280; above it, the first resistance is $2,360, followed by the $2,385 opening level. If ETH gets back above $2,300 but repeatedly fails at $2,360, that is still a weak relief bounce. A fresh break below $2,280 without a quick recovery would invalidate my assumption that the market is stabilizing in the short term. Only if ETH can retest and hold $2,300, then reclaim $2,360, would it make sense to discuss a move back toward $2,385. Next week’s FOMC decision has not yet been announced, so any position plan must allow for unexpected volatility; market probabilities are not the same as the actual decision.

If I were trading this myself, I’d sit this one out for now: no buying the dip and no high-leverage short. I’d only consider a spot long using 2% of my total capital after ETH decisively moves above $2,360 and then retests and holds $2,330. My first target would be $2,385, where I’d take half off; my second target would be $2,420, where I’d sell the remaining half. I’d place the initial stop below $2,290. If ETH fell back below $2,300 after I entered, I’d close the position early. If the entry trigger isn’t met, I’ll stay out of the market. Managing risk matters more than guessing the exact bottom.

Sources: Binance News market update, Farside ETH fund flow table, and live Kraken ETH/USD prices. #ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH｜跌破2300后重新站回｜基金表缺栏时不急着抄底

我的态度是继续防守，ETH重新站回2300美元并不等于抛压已经结束。币安News已验证账号按币安行情记录：10月24日15:17（UTC），ETH短暂跌破2300 USDT，报约2291.09 USDT，较此前24小时下跌约4.5%。这是当时的市场快讯，不代表此刻仍在该价位。我刚核对Kraken ETH/USD约2335.1美元，虽然重新站回2300，但低于本日2384.7美元开盘价，日内低点约2279.8美元。两家交易所的交易对和时间不同，不能把它们当成同一笔成交，也不能把反弹直接称为趋势反转。

我还会看机构需求，而不是只看一个整数关口。Farside当前表格显示10月22日美国ETH现货ETF合计约净流出1.106亿美元；10月23日表面合计约净流入440万美元，但ETHV栏仍是空缺符号，不宜把这一天当作完整终值，更不能由此宣称机构已经全面回流。短期机制很简单：价格下探可能触发杠杆仓位被迫减仓，随后又有低位回补；基金流向的时间尺度更慢，未必与盘中波动一一对应。因此当日跌破2300和次日表格缺栏，最多支持谨慎观察，不支持「ETF资金救市」这类结论。若后续补录明显转强，再更新判断。

我的观察位是2300美元能否稳住，下面看2280美元附近当日低点，上面看2360美元第一阻力及2385美元开盘位。回到2300上方但反复受阻于2360，仍属弱反抽；若重新跌破2280且无法快速收复，就推翻我对短线企稳的假设。若能够回踩不破2300、再站稳2360，才有资格讨论向2385回补。下周FOMC结果尚未公布，仓位计划必须容纳意外波动，不把市场概率当成决议。

如果是我自己交易，我现在选择不参与，暂不抄底，也不做高杠杆空单。只在ETH有效站上2360美元、回踩守住2330美元后，用总资金2%现货试多；第一目标2385美元，先减一半，第二目标2420美元，再减剩余一半。初始止损放在2290美元下方；若入场后又跌破2300美元，我会提前平仓。未满足入场触发就保持空仓，风险控制比猜最低点重要。

来源：币安News行情快讯、Farside ETH基金流量表、Kraken ETH/USD即时行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Does the Candlestick You FOMO Into Usually Look Like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the group chat is yelling to buy, and your hand slips as you chase in—only to end up buying at
the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it's what those already fully invested want you to chase in and take
your bags. Chasing after a high-volume surge is essentially providing liquidity to those who got in earlier.

A simple but effective method: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on declining volume and the price stabilizes,
you'll get a better entry. If it drops straight back down, congratulations—you've saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won't give you your capital back a second time.

الضغط لم يبدأ من العملات الرقمية وحدها.
يوم الجمعة، أغلقت الأسواق الأمريكية على تراجع؛ انخفض مؤشر S&P 500 بنحو 0.52%، وناسداك بنحو 0.21%، بعد موجة بيع سابقة غذّتها مخاوف بشأن الإنفاق على الذكاء الاصطناعي والتقييمات المرتفعة لبعض أسهم التكنولوجيا.
لماذا يهمنا ذلك؟
لأن جزءًا من المستثمرين يتعامل مع البيتكوين والعملات الرقمية باعتبارها أصولًا عالية المخاطر. عندما ترتفع المخاوف في الأسواق، قد يقلل المستثمرون انكشافهم على هذه الأصول بدلًا من انتظار مزيد من الخسائر.
لكن هذا لا يعني أن البيتكوين يتحرك دائمًا مثل الأسهم؛ العلاقة تتغير بحسب ظروف السوق والسيولة.

2. ارتفاع النفط والتوترات الجيوسياسية 🛢️
من التطورات المهمة أيضًا ارتفاع أسعار النفط.
وفق Reuters، استقر خام برنت يوم الجمعة عند 116.72 دولارًا للبرميل، وهو أعلى مستوى له منذ 29 أبريل، وسط مخاوف من اضطرابات الإمدادات بعد هجمات الحوثيين في السعودية. كما بقي عائد سندات الخزانة الأمريكية لأجل عشر سنوات مرتفعًا عند نحو 4.99%. 
ما علاقة النفط بالكريبتو؟
إذا استمرت أسعار الطاقة مرتفعة، فقد تتزايد المخاوف من التضخم، ما يعقّد مهمة البنوك المركزية في خفض أسعار الفائدة. وقد يؤدي ذلك إلى استمرار الظروف المالية المشددة وتراجع شهية المخاطرة.
هذه قناة ضغط محتملة ومدعومة بسياق الأسواق، وليست دليلًا على أن ارتفاع النفط وحده تسبب في هبوط البيتكوين.

3. خروج الأموال من صناديق البيتكوين المتداولة 💸
هذه نقطة تستحق المتابعة.
بحسب بيانات SoSoValue التي نقلتها تقارير السوق، سجلت صناديق البيتكوين الفورية الأمريكية:
- 22 أكتوبر: صافي تدفقات خارجة بنحو 635.5 مليون دولار.
- 23 أكتوبر: تدفقات خارجة إضافية بنحو 137.9 مليون دولار.
أي نحو 773 مليون دولار من صافي التدفقات الخارجة خلال يومين. 
لماذا هذا مهم؟
لأن تدفقات الصناديق تعطينا مؤشرًا على الطلب الاستثماري عبر هذه المنتجات. عندما تتحول التدفقات إلى الخارج، فإن ذلك قد يزيد الضغط على السوق، خصوصًا إذا تزامن مع ضعف فني وتصفيات مرتفعة.
لكن لا ينبغي تفسير كل دولار يخرج من الصناديق على أنه بيع مباشر وفوري لعملة بيتكوين في السوق؛ فالتدفقات وحدها لا تكشف كل تفاصيل تنفيذ الصفقات أو دوافع المستثمرين.

4. التصفيات القسرية: عندما يتحول الهبوط إلى سلسلة متتابعة ⚠️
في رأيي، هذه من أهم النقاط لفهم سرعة الهبوط.
وفق تقرير The Block، بلغت تصفيات مراكز الكريبتو نحو 436 مليون دولار خلال أربع ساعات فقط يوم السبت، منها قرابة 404 ملايين دولار في مراكز الشراء (Longs). 

كيف تعمل هذه الدوامة؟
1. ينخفض السعر ويقترب من مستويات تصفية بعض المتداولين.
2. تُغلق المنصات مراكزهم قسرًا عندما لا يعود الهامش كافيًا.
3. تؤدي عمليات الإغلاق إلى مزيد من الضغط على الأسعار، بحسب ظروف السيولة والتنفيذ.
4. تتعرض مراكز أخرى للتصفية، فتتسارع الحركة.
وهكذا قد يتحول هبوط بدأ بصورة تدريجية إلى حركة عنيفة خلال وقت قصير.
تنبيه مهم: قيمة المراكز المصفّاة ليست مساوية للخسائر النقدية الصافية للمتداولين، ولا تعني أن المبلغ نفسه خرج من السوق.

🧩 ثالثًا: لماذا تهبط العملات البديلة أكثر من البيتكوين؟
عندما يتراجع البيتكوين بقوة، قد تتعرض العملات البديلة لضغط أكبر لعدة أسباب:
- سيولتها أقل في كثير من الحالات، ما يجعل حركة السعر أكثر حدة.
- بعض المتداولين يخفّضون المخاطر في العملات الأصغر أولًا.
- الرافعة المالية قد تضخّم الحركة في الاتجاهين.
- الخوف العام قد يدفع المستثمرين إلى الابتعاد عن الأصول الأكثر تقلبًا.

لهذا قد ترى البيتكوين يتراجع بنسبة محدودة نسبيًا، بينما تخسر بعض العملات البديلة 5% أو 10% أو أكثر.
لكن ليس كل مشروع متساويًا؛ فهناك فرق بين هبوط السوق كله وبين تراجع عملة بسبب مشكلة خاصة بمشروعها أو ضعف سيولتها.

🔮 رابعًا: إلى متى سيستمر الهبوط؟
لا توجد بيانات موثوقة تسمح بتحديد يوم انتهاء الهبوط أو الجزم بأن القاع قد تحقق. وأي شخص يعطيك موعدًا مؤكدًا الآن يقدم توقعًا، لا حقيقة.
بدلًا من محاولة تخمين القاع، أراقب ثلاثة سيناريوهات:
🟢 السيناريو الأول: ارتداد واستعادة التوازن
إذا استعاد البيتكوين مستويات مهمة، وهدأت التصفيات، وتحسنت تدفقات صناديق الاستثمار، فقد نشهد ارتدادًا أو مرحلة استقرار.
لكن ارتداد السعر لا يعني وحده أن الاتجاه الهابط انتهى؛ نحتاج إلى تأكيد على الأطر الزمنية الأكبر.

🟡 السيناريو الثاني: تذبذب واستمرار الضغط
قد يتحرك السوق في نطاق عرضي مع ارتدادات سريعة وهبوطات جديدة، خصوصًا إذا بقيت الأسواق العالمية متوترة ولم يتحسن الطلب.
هذا السيناريو قد يكون مرهقًا للمتداولين الذين يدخلون مع كل حركة صغيرة.

🔴 السيناريو الثالث: موجة هبوط إضافية
إذا كسر البيتكوين دعومًا مهمة وأغلق دونها، مع استمرار ضعف الأسهم وخروج الأموال من الصناديق وارتفاع التصفيات، فقد يتعرض السوق لموجة ضغط جديدة.
لكن لا يمكن تأكيد هذا السيناريو دون متابعة حركة السعر والبيانات الجديدة.
وهناك حدث اقتصادي قريب يستحق الانتباه: اجتماع الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الأمريكي يومي 27 و28 أكتوبر 2026. قد تؤثر قراراته وتصريحاته في توقعات الفائدة وشهية المخاطرة، لكن اتجاه رد فعل السوق غير مضمون مسبقًا.

🎯 خامسًا: كيف أتعامل مع السوق في هذه المرحلة؟
في مثل هذه الظروف، لا أعتبر كل هبوط فرصة شراء، ولا أعتبر كل ارتداد بداية سوق صاعدة جديدة.
أراقب:
- البيتكوين على فريم 4 ساعات واليومي: هل يستعيد هيكله السعري أم يواصل تسجيل قمم وقيعان هابطة؟
- مناطق السيولة: هل نشهد سحبًا للسيولة أسفل القيعان، ثم استعادة للمستويات المكسورة؟
- تدفقات صناديق الاستثمار: هل يستمر خروج الأموال أم تظهر عودة واضحة للطلب؟
- التصفيات والرافعة المالية: هل تهدأ موجة الإغلاقات القسرية؟
- الأسواق العالمية والنفط: هل تتراجع الضغوط الاقتصادية والجيوسياسية أم تتفاقم؟
وبالنسبة إلى التداول الفوري (Spot)، لا أرى ضرورة لاستثمار كامل السيولة في محاولة اصطياد قاع قد لا يكون قد تشكل بعد. الدخول التدريجي قد يكون خيارًا لبعض المستثمرين، لكنه لا يلغي احتمال استمرار الهبوط، ويجب أن يتناسب مع خطة المخاطر والأفق الزمني.

🧠 الخلاصة: هل انتهى السوق الصاعد؟
حتى الآن، ما نملكه هو دليل على ضغط قوي ناتج عن تداخل عوامل اقتصادية وتدفقات استثمارية وتصفيات للمراكز ذات الرافعة المالية. لكن هذه البيانات وحدها لا تكفي للحكم بأن السوق دخل شتاءً طويلًا، ولا لتأكيد أن الهبوط مجرد تصحيح مؤقت.
الشيء الذي أريد من كل متداول تذكّره هو:
لا تحاول أن تكون أول من يشتري القاع؛ حاول أن تفهم ما الذي يحدث، وما الذي سيبطل فكرتك، وكم يمكنك تحمّل خسارته إذا كنت مخطئًا.
السوق سيمنح فرصًا أخرى، لكن رأس المال الذي تخسره بسبب قرار متسرع قد لا يعود بسهولة.

💬 والآن أريد رأيكم بصراحة:
هل ترون ما يحدث فرصة لتجميع العملات الجيدة على مراحل، أم أن الأفضل الانتظار حتى يستعيد البيتكوين اتجاهه ويظهر تأكيد واضح؟
وهل تعتقدون أن السبب الأهم وراء الهبوط هو التصفيات والرافعة المالية، أم خروج السيولة، أم الضغوط الاقتصادية العالمية؟
شاركوني تحليلكم في التعليقات؛ النقاش المبني على البيانات أفضل من إطلاق توقعات بلا دليل. 👇

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You’re Stuck Holding a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Notice that this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you’re stuck holding a trade, you’ll automatically seek out good news and tune out bad news. That’s called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
is invalidated,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

📰 ETFs suddenly bleed $404M, Bitcoin nearly falls below $80K, whale liquidations add insult to injury—what’s really driving the fear?

We talked about this just two days ago, and now there’s a new development. ETFs were supposed to help stabilize Bitcoin, but U.S. tech stocks suddenly ran into trouble, funds flowed back into the bond market, and ETFs saw $40.4 billion in outflows in a single day. On top of that, two whales were liquidated on Hyperliquid today. An $8.05M BTC long position was liquidated, resulting in a $278K loss, and Bitcoin fell straight below $80,000. Why say this drop wasn’t a coincidence?

Bitcoin’s recent fall below $80,000 has two main causes. First, ETFs suddenly saw massive outflows, hurting market sentiment. Second, two large traders had their highly leveraged positions on Hyperliquid forcibly liquidated, releasing a large amount of Bitcoin onto the market. For everyday investors, this means selling pressure could be greater than expected.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?

The root cause is a crack in market confidence. ETF outflows suggest institutional investors are reassessing the risk-reward balance, while the whale liquidations have exposed the risks of high leverage among some traders. These two events are like two rocks hitting a calm lake at once: in the short term, they’re driving a sentiment-fueled sell-off; over the longer term, they reflect a trend of capital moving out of high-risk assets.

Impact on the Market

For BTC, $80,000 is an important psychological level. If it gives way, it could trigger more stop-loss orders. Historically, each time Bitcoin has fallen below this level, it has gone through a period of bottoming out. But the backdrop is different this time—regulatory uncertainty remains, while institutional capital is pulling out, which means downside pressure could be significant.

Trading Outlook

At this point, Bitcoin is more likely to continue falling toward $77,000 in the short term. ETF outflows aren’t an isolated event; they’re a signal of a broader reallocation of capital. If the Federal Reserve announces an interest-rate cut next, this outlook no longer applies. This article is not sponsored by any project, and the author does not hold any of the assets mentioned.

📰 ETF突然出血404M，比特币险些跌破8万，鲸鱼爆仓雪上加霜到底怕什么？

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。说好的ETF要稳住比特币，结果美国科技股突然出事，资金回流到债券市场，ETF一天流出404亿美元。加上今天两大鲸鱼在Hyperliquid上爆仓，$8.05M的BTC多头被清算亏掉$278K，比特币直接跌破$80,000。为什么说这次下跌不是偶然？

最近比特币跌破$80,000，主要原因有两个。第一是ETF突然流出巨量资金，市场情绪受挫。第二是有两个大户在Hyperliquid上做的高杠杆仓位被强制平仓，释放了大量比特币。这对普通投资者来说，意味着市场的抛压可能比想象中要大。

News about big-name traders getting liquidated makes for compelling reading, but what you should really watch is the “frequency of liquidations,” not the names.

According to reports, Machi Big Brother’s (Machi) account was liquidated five times in about an hour, with its balance falling to around $5,000. Earlier, some of his ETH long positions were also forcibly liquidated after a sharp market drop. Multiple liquidations in a short period often point to high leverage, adding to losing positions, or a chain reaction.

How to read this: Don’t mechanically treat someone else’s liquidation as a contrarian signal to buy the dip. For the market, cascading liquidations can temporarily amplify volatility. For individuals, what matters more is reviewing your margin ratio and rules for adding to positions—adding more in the same direction until your margin gets thinner is often more fatal than getting a single call wrong. Before turning “holding through the loss” into a rule, first make sure you still have capital for another try.

Just two days ago, we talked about Bitcoin’s $80.8K support level. But over the weekend, a massive sell-off triggered by liquidations sent the price crashing to $79,146. Leveraged traders suffered hundreds of millions of dollars in direct losses over the weekend, and the price hit a more-than-one-month low. For those who have been bearish on Bitcoin, this is practically a gift of fresh material.

Why does this news matter?
This wasn’t simply a price fluctuation. It was a chain reaction triggered by leveraged positions being forcibly liquidated outside trading hours (over the weekend). Forced liquidations in futures contracts instantly amplified selling pressure in the spot market. This means:
- What’s been exposed is the fragility of leveraged funding chains, not a problem with Bitcoin itself
- This kind of irrational weekend selling often signals a fundamental loss of market confidence
- Historical data shows that short-term crashes triggered by leveraged liquidations are usually followed by 1–2 days of “downward momentum”

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin’s breach of the psychological $80K support level could lead to:
- Panic spreading among holders, triggering further stop-loss orders
- Institutional investors reassessing their risk exposure and potentially reducing their positions
- Exchanges tightening risk controls, for example, by raising margin requirements

But what’s more worth watching is how much of the $316M in liquidations came from over-the-counter derivatives. If those funds were borrowed, that would mean a debt crisis is spreading into mainstream markets.

Trading strategy
To me, the breach of the $80K defense line is more of a confirmation signal—Bitcoin is likely to keep testing lower levels in the short term. The level to watch is around $78K; if the price finds a floor there, it may be able to stabilize temporarily. translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t Admitting You’re Wrong—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can’t bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Look at it from another angle: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever seen cuts his losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you set a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

About $815M was liquidated across the market in 24 hours, affecting roughly 200,000 traders. Futures open interest fell 2.2% to about $140.1B.
📌 BTC briefly fell to around $79,280; ETH was around $2,314 (-3.8%). ETH liquidations totaled $137M, nearly matching BTC’s $158M, despite ETH’s market cap being only about 18% of BTC’s.
📌 SoSoValue: BTC spot ETFs saw combined outflows of about $773M on Thursday and Friday. ETH ETFs recorded net outflows on 14 of October’s 17 trading days, totaling about $1.175B.

This wasn’t spot-market panic; it was a leverage flush. Longs accounted for over 90% of liquidations, and ETH’s share was notably high, suggesting that longs in altcoins and ETH were the most crowded. Machi got liquidated five times in an hour, leaving around $5,000 in his wallet. That Lookonchain post got 75,000 views. The comments were full of people laughing again.

Honestly, I think the people laughing at him should be doing more soul-searching than he does.

Look at the position he opened the day before: 25x long on 315 ETH, entry price $2,447.57, liquidation price $2,336.9. Do the math: he was only about 4.5% away from liquidation. What’s a 4.5% drop in ETH on a Saturday night? It’s not even a real market move—it’s just normal volatility. This isn’t about getting the market call wrong; it’s about leaving yourself no room to be wrong.

Here’s another detail: the cumulative loss figures reported by different outlets don’t even match. Some say $35.35 million, others $37.05 million or $37 million. Nobody can even be bothered to check the numbers—they just copy, paste, and post. Why? Because Machi getting liquidated is a reliable traffic magnet. It happens every week, like a TV show. Someone even charted his account balance: $150,000 to $12 million to $800,000 to $10 million, then back to $150,000. It looks thrilling, but basically he’s a machine constantly feeding the liquidation engine.

Even crazier, one post claimed that right after getting liquidated, he opened another 25x long with 50 ETH. A celebrity can play like this because he can afford to lose—or because this is part of his personal brand. If you laugh along and then open your own 20x position and stubbornly hold it, you’re the real joke.

If you actually want to learn something, take away just one lesson: before entering a trade, check how far the liquidation price is from the current price, then ask yourself whether you can handle a normal weekend wick of that size. If you can’t, don’t open the position. It’s that simple.

translatedData.content:
ETH client discovers block-building timing issue | Fix proposal still under review | Wait for confirmation around 2313

My stance is to prioritize staying on the sidelines: this is development progress for an Ethereum execution client, not a sign that the mainnet has ground to a halt, nor a buy signal. The Geth project’s October 23 issue log describes a specific edge case: when testing inclusion lists on a development network, a client may execute the transactions in the list synchronously to first construct a block payload that satisfies the list, potentially delaying the return of a new payload ID to the consensus client. If this coincides with the proposal deadline, the consensus client may reuse an old ID, resulting in a payload that does not meet the new inclusion-list requirements. On October 24, a developer proposed an asynchronous building approach: validate the parameters, return the ID as early as possible, and then wait for the build result. The proposal is still open for review, depends on another piece of work, and the developer has also said that testing on the development network and the full specification tests are not yet complete. “A fix has been proposed” must not be presented as “it has been merged and deployed,” and a development-network issue must not be portrayed as a widespread mainnet failure.

Why should traders care? Inclusion lists concern the rules for including transactions in future blocks. The reliability of block-building timing affects the implementation risk of the upgrade and the validator experience; it does not directly create immediate buying demand for ETH. In the short term, sentiment is more likely to be affected by market expectations around upgrade progress. The milestones that can actually be verified are code review, merging, cross-client testing, and the official upgrade schedule—not the popularity of a single discussion post. I checked the Binance Square trending list: the leading topics are currently macroeconomics, stablecoins, and other tokens, with no popular tag directly related to this client proposal, so I won’t force a connection. Macroeconomic interest rates, ETF flows, and risk appetite may still outweigh this kind of engineering news.

Market reactions should be judged using independent data: at the time of writing, Kraken ETH spot was around $2,313, with a rolling range low of about $2,280 and a high of about $2,408; the daily open was around $2,385. The price is below the daily open, but that does not prove the proposal caused the decline. 2313 is just a reference point, not inherently a support level. First, watch whether buyers continue to defend the area around 2280; above, watch whether the price can regain and hold around the 2385 daily open, then look toward the range high of 2408. If the price repeatedly fails to break above 2385 and falls below 2280, my expectation of a short-term recovery is invalidated. I would only consider changing my wait-and-see stance if the price recovers 2385 on increased volume and holds it on a retest. During extreme volatility, I would not treat a single wick to a low as confirmation.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter now and would remain directionally neutral, with a planned spot position of 0% for now and no high leverage. Only if ETH regains 2385 and holds above it on a retest would I consider joining the move with a test position of no more than 3% of total trading capital. I would first target 2408, sell half at that level, and watch whether the remaining position forms a higher low. I would exit at a loss if the price falls back to 2313 or the position loses about 2% after entry, whichever comes first. In the alternative scenario, if the price breaks below 2280, I would not chase a short; I would wait for it to reclaim that level before reassessing. If new information about macroeconomic conditions or ETF flows points the other way, the original plan is immediately void. These are all conditional plans and do not mean that any trades have been executed or that any profits have been made.

Sources: Official Geth issue and fix proposal, the original Ethereum EIP-7805, and Kraken ETH/USD spot quotes. #ETH
The above reflects only my personal market observations and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH客户端发现打包时序问题｜修复提案仍待审｜2313附近先等确认

我的态度是观望优先：这是以太坊执行客户端的开发进展，不是主网已经停摆，也不是买入信号。Geth项目10月23日的议题记录了一个具体边界情况：在开发网络测试包含列表时，客户端为了先构造满足列表的区块载荷，同步执行列表中的交易，可能拖慢向共识客户端返回新的载荷编号。若赶上提议时点，共识端可能沿用旧编号，导致载荷不符合新的包含列表要求。10月24日有开发者提出异步构建方案，先验证参数、尽早返回编号，再等待构建结果；该提案目前仍开放审查，依赖另一项工作，开发者也说明尚未跑完开发网络与完整规范测试。不能把“提出修复”写成“已合并上线”，更不能把开发网现象写成主网普遍故障。

这为什么值得交易者关心？包含列表关系到未来区块纳入交易的规则，打包时序是否可靠，影响的是升级落地的执行风险和验证者体验，不会直接给ETH创造即时买盘。短线更可能通过市场对升级进度的预期影响情绪；真正可验证的节点，应是代码审查、合并、跨客户端测试及正式升级日程，而不是单个讨论帖的热度。我看过币安广场趋势榜，当前靠前的是宏观、稳定币和其他币种话题，并无与此项客户端提案直接对应的热门标签，所以不硬蹭。宏观利率、ETF资金和风险偏好依然可能盖过这类工程消息。

市场反应要按独立数据说话：写稿时Kraken ETH现货约2313美元，滚动区间低约2280、高约2408，日开约2385；价格低于日开，但无法证明跌幅由这项提案造成。2313只是观察锚点，不是天然支撑。下方先看2280附近是否继续被买盘守住；上方看2385日开附近能否重新站稳，再看2408区间高位。若反复冲不过2385且跌破2280，我对短线修复的期待就失效；若放量收复2385并在回踩时保持，才考虑改变观望态度。极端波动时不以单根针插低点作为确认。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向保持中性，现货计划仓位先记为0%，不做高杠杆。只有ETH重新站稳2385并回踩不破，我才用总交易资金不超过3%的试探仓顺势参与；目标先看2408，触及后减掉一半，余仓观察是否形成更高低点，跌回2313或入场后亏损达到约2%就止损平仓，以先发生者为准。另一种情形是跌破2280，我不追空，等重新夺回该位再评估；若宏观或ETF资金出现相反新信息，原计划立即作废。以上均为条件计划，不代表已经成交或获利。

At $2,322, the key thing to read isn’t the 3.51% drop. It’s that the funding rate has flipped to -0.0052% while the share of long accounts is still sitting at 76.9%.

Taken together, these two figures are contradictory. A negative funding rate means perpetual futures are trading at a discount to spot, with shorts paying longs to hold their positions. But by account count, nearly 80% of traders are on the long side. One way to understand it: there are more longs, but the money is on the short side. If this were a liquidation of leveraged longs, the funding rate would usually plunge deeply negative before quickly returning to positive, and the long-account share would collapse along with it. Longs haven’t collapsed, while the funding rate is holding firmly in negative territory. That suggests someone is willing to keep paying to maintain short exposure—a very different situation from forced position closures after liquidations.

The on-chain news offers a more concrete clue: an early address with a cost basis of $0.31 sold 1,000 ETH, worth about $2.32 million at current prices and just 0.03% of the 24-hour trading volume of 7.16 billion USDT. That trade alone can’t explain a 3.51% drop, so it shouldn’t be treated as the culprit behind the sell-off. What really matters is the cost basis it represents. Coins accumulated in the early days have no stop-loss levels and don’t follow moving averages or round-number price levels; they’re sold only when there’s a need to cash out. Selling pressure from this kind of supply has nothing to do with whether the price is high or low: they sell as it rises, and keep selling when it falls. So the question is no longer why this address is selling now, but how many more addresses with a $0.31 cost basis are waiting in line.

The open-interest figure of 5.366 billion USDT rules out the leveraged-liquidation scenario. If a cascade of liquidations were underway, open interest would plunge sharply alongside the price, rather than remaining at this level. The price is falling, but open interest hasn’t collapsed accordingly, and the funding rate has turned negative. This combination points to spot selling without a mass retreat by leveraged traders. Shorts are gradually building positions and collecting funding, while the number of longs hasn’t fallen yet. This structure isn’t healthy, but it’s not panic either; it looks more like an orderly distribution.

The broader environment hasn’t helped ETH, either. BTC has fallen below 81,000, and the market is interpreting the decline as leveraged positions being flushed out amid an AI-driven sell-off in tech stocks. Analysts have put the range at 80,000–85,000. ETH has no catalyst of its own to attract capital. As risk appetite contracts, it’s simply a high-beta asset that follows the market—and one with early holders’ coins hanging overhead. When beta returns, it rises more, but the selling pressure is there at the same time.

My view is neutral to cautious: this drop is driven by the cashing out of spot holdings with near-zero cost bases, not by leveraged liquidations. So a rebound won’t be especially quick just because this is a liquidation-driven market—the sellers haven’t been forced out; they’ve simply chosen to sell. Keep an eye on three things: whether early addresses continue transferring coins to exchanges; whether the funding rate can move from -0.0052% back toward zero without the price falling; and whether open interest continues to decline along with the price. If only the first of these deteriorates, the downside is limited. If all three happen at once, that’s when it’s time to get defensive.
